title: Nondeterministic register instructions
statement: For $m$ registers, $d$ deciders, and a set $\Lambda$ of control states, a nondeterministic register instruction is either a deterministic register instruction or a choice instruction with two successor states $\ell_1,\ell_0\in\Lambda$, selected according to whether the choice bit is $1$ or $0$.
